integrity: Analytic proof, explicit definitions, finite-sum coefficients and independently implemented finite verifier are provided; finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic expansion fixes alphabet size and radius while blocklength grows; it samples uniformly over multisets, not randomly ordered strings. The exact frequency spectrum covers ternary radius two and n>=6. The formula does not itself give a new code-size bound. Independent review is outstanding.
title: Two-face fluctuation law for multiset deletion-ball volumes
